graph.name: Sanofi Real World Evidence Analytics Platform
graph.notes: Sanofi built a secure analytics portal on AWS using S3 static hosting, CloudFront, Cognito federated with corporate SSO, API Gateway, DynamoDB for audit tracing, Service Catalog for provisioning R Studio and SageMaker environments, and Lambda with Translate and Comprehend Medical for NLP processing.

nodes.name: Users
nodes.notes: Data scientists and analysts accessing the Real World Evidence analytics platform.

nodes.name: CloudFront
nodes.notes: CloudFront CDN distribution holding the SSL certificate and reducing portal serving costs.

nodes.name: Sanofi SSO
nodes.notes: Corporate identity provider integrated for single sign-on.

nodes.name: Cognito
nodes.notes: Handles user identity federation and authentication with Sanofi SSO.

nodes.name: S3 Portal Bucket
nodes.notes: Static website hosting bucket serving as the user entry portal.

nodes.name: API Gateway
nodes.notes: API management layer handling dynamic portal requests and user tracking.

nodes.name: DynamoDB
nodes.notes: Stores user metadata and audit logs for all actions performed on the portal.

nodes.name: Service Catalog
nodes.notes: Deploys standardized data science products using CloudFormation.

nodes.name: Lambda
nodes.notes: Serverless orchestration functions invoking Translate and Comprehend Medical SDKs.

nodes.name: R Studio
nodes.notes: Dedicated compute instances provisioned for R Studio data analysis.

nodes.name: SageMaker
nodes.notes: SageMaker Notebook instances provisioned with 100GB encrypted disks per user.

nodes.name: Translate
nodes.notes: Performs bulk automated translation of raw data files.

nodes.name: Comprehend Medical
nodes.notes: Identifies medical entities and sensitive medical metadata in raw files.

nodes.name: Data Lake
nodes.notes: Central data lake with user home buckets enforcing strict data segregation.

edges.notes: Users connect to the static web portal via CloudFront.
CloudFront serves portal content stored in the static S3 bucket.
Sanofi SSO federates user authentication with Cognito.
Cognito authenticates user sessions for portal access.
Portal routes dynamic operations to API Gateway.
API Gateway records user actions and metadata in DynamoDB for traceability.
Users request creation of analytics environments through Service Catalog.
Service Catalog provisions R Studio compute instances.
Service Catalog provisions SageMaker Notebooks with encrypted disks.
Portal triggers Lambda functions to perform NLP data processing.
Lambda uses the Translate SDK for automated document translation.
Lambda uses the Comprehend Medical SDK to identify medical entities.
